selection_rule: Only candidates passing all six inherited gates. Rank by highest minimum Spotify recall at 10/20/30, then highest ten-packet correct count, then lowest Spotify training mass. If none pass, stop without another fit.
data_roles: Same 14000 public training, 62 existing local YT/IG and 17 new role=train Spotify flows. Existing spotify-dev-01 stays selection only, never training; original 17 local YT/IG and first50 public selection/class are reused retention. Original diagnostic, calibration, final and other capture scopes are excluded.
limits: Offline development-only follow-up authorized after the prior failed study. Three fixed lower-weight candidates, same seed/model/feature semantics, no augmentation, no new recording, no transferred confidence, no calibration, deployment or promotion. Old failure remains immutable. Reused exposed selection can overfit: any selected candidate requires a separately frozen fresh verification/calibration protocol before use. No broad accuracy or causality claim. A failed scope stops without weight-grid expansion.
